text: Or, it is the rod of my sonne, it despiseth euery tree.
Or, they are thrust downe to the sword with my people. , Iere.31.19.
Or, when the triall hath beene, what then? shall they not also belong to the despising rod?
Or, glittering, or feare. , Or, sharpened.
Heb. set thy selfe, take the left hand.
Heb. mother of the way. , Or, kniues. , Heb. Teraphim.
Or, for the oathes made vnto them.
Heb. peruerted, peruerted, peruerted will I make it.
Or, cause to it to returne.
